name: Boulder Technologies
old_description: Boulder Technologies, LLC is an independent board level electronic components distributor
about:
Boulder Technologies, LLC operates from Dover, New Hampshire, where it has served the electronics supply chain for over 25 years. The company was founded as an independent distributor of board-level electronic components, though a specific founding year and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The firm specializes in sourcing and supplying integrated circuits, passive components, and other board-level parts, with a focus on RoHS-compliant inventory. It offers excess inventory management and outright purchase programs for idle stock, providing flexible, value-added services tailored to dynamic market conditions. The company emphasizes its experienced staff and marketing strategies to act as an independent strategic partner.

Its customer base includes electronic manufacturers, contract manufacturers, original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), and telecommunication equipment manufacturers. The company positions itself as a supplier that stands behind every component sold, with safeguards against fraud and counterfeit products.

Boulder Technologies differentiates itself through its commitment to customer-specific needs, aggressive buying of IC and passive component material, and a policy of backing each component against unscrupulous practices.
